record.provider: Gcore Free CDN (1 TB/mo traffic, no card)

free_tier.stated: 1 TB/month included traffic and 1 billion requests on the free PAYG plan at €0/month. Verified against Gcore's own pricing payload: 'Included FREE Traffic 1 TB/Month', 'Traffic overage (per GB) €0.01', 'Requests over 1B (per 1M) €0.75'. No trial period. It is a standing free plan.

egress.terms: The free 1 TB/month IS the egress. Overage €0.01/GB (≈$10/TB). Separately, Gcore Object Storage has free egress to Gcore CDN and free ingress.

record.tooling: Standard CDN pull-zone config; origin can be any URL. No card needed for the CDN free plan (confirmed: 'CDN (Free) … Free plan has no trial period, but has a 1 TB traffic limit' with no card condition listed).
record.chaining: Free plan includes 1 TB per month (~33 GB per day) across 210+ edge locations without credit card verification. Multiple email-only accounts each receive the standard monthly bandwidth allowance. Storage at rest costs €0.04 per GiB.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: none published. The binding limit is the 1 TB/month traffic counter plus 1B requests. Gcore blocks Gcore storage if a plan payment fails, which can cascade into CDN suspension.
record.reliability_note: 210+ PoPs, 200+ Tbps. Origin-shielding is 'Basic' on the free plan. Free tier has been reshaped before (was 100 GB until ~2025, then moved to 1 TB), so budget for the number moving.

evidence.proved: 'CDN (Free) | Not available | Free plan has no trial period, but has a 1 TB traffic limit'
S3 Standard €0.04/GiB/mo, 'Egress to CDN Free', 'Ingress Free'

record.price_per_tb_month: $0 for the first 1 TB/mo; $10/TB beyond (€0.01/GB). Object storage €0.04/GiB/mo ≈ €40/TB ≈ $46/TB — not a viable origin.
